phone.changelog:
• Continuous Commercial-Grade Heart Rate Sync: Optical PPG measurement streams live continuous BPM directly into daily logs, clinical zones, and database
• Low-Confidence/Accuracy 0 Optical PPG Support: Captures every human pulse reading (25–240 BPM) without dropping raw sensor frames
• Enhanced Live Metrics: Real-time workout companion screen updates with instant watch heart rate feedback

watch.changelog:
• Super-Accurate Gait Step Tracking: Signed linear acceleration with dynamic gravity low-pass filtering and 4-step cadence debounce eliminates false steps and zeroes
• Continuous Commercial-Grade Heart Rate Measuring: Optical PPG sensor actively measures and streams continuous live BPM across watch faces, tiles, and workout screens just like major smartwatch brands
• Hardware Watchdog & Clock Skew Guard: Seamless fallback to software acceleration if hardware step counter stalls, with wall-clock time preservation for MTK/Android 8 optical sensors
